etymology: a prolonged form of a primary verb
avSummary: grow 12, increase 7, give the increase 2, grow up 1
definition:
1) to cause to grow, augment
 2) to increase, become greater
 3) to grow, increase
    3a) of plants
    3b) of infants
    3c) of a multitude of people
    3d) of inward Christian growth
